theme: The last open day before Croatia.
greeting: A quiet Sunday in St. Pete with the girls, Dan — one short review with Mike, then the day opens up. The Croatia bookings that close when you fly Tuesday are the one thing worth carving time for.

needsAttention.title: Croatia's last bookings close Tuesday
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat hotel and the noon marina transfer, plus written proof the checked bags are on the Eurowings ticket — all p1, all only doable from dry land before you board. Charter connectivity won't save you underway.

needsAttention.title: St Pete nights Sept 20-22 still open
needsAttention.detail: The two nights between the Croatia landing and the Tuesday school pickup aren't booked yet. The Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb is also still pending host confirmation and worth a glance.

needsAttention.title: Halloween and the backup rental decide tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: Both are overdue and both were meant to be settled before Croatia. The Oct 18-Nov 1 St Pete booking and the refundable Sept 20-Oct 5 SUV both fire while you're at sea, so tomorrow is the last clean day to choose.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: Nail down the Sat Sept 12 boarding time and the Sept 19 return transfer now — the packet says arrange the transfer early, and bandwidth drops once you're underway.

needsAttention.title: Andrew Kaufmann wants to reconnect
needsAttention.detail: A LinkedIn note this morning — he thinks you may have left KPMG and would welcome the chance to reconnect. A quick reply keeps a warm networking thread alive.

flagged.title: Amex balance rose
flagged.detail: A myFICO alert flagged your American Express monthly balance ticking up — automated, no action needed unless it's a surprise.

inbox.noise: The rest is Labor Day sales, shop promos, and newsletters — Bloomberg, NYT Cooking, NativShark, The Company Store and a couple dozen more.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Autumn's first hard squashes and sweet cipolline onions are coming into their own now.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + power strip

acts.line: The 9 AM review with Mike wraps by 9:15 — the rest of the morning is yours.
An open Labor Day-weekend afternoon in St. Pete with the four girls.
Tomorrow is the last dry-land day before Tuesday's flight, so the Cavtat and baggage bookings are worth an hour tonight.
